title: Peter's Vision and Cornelius
description: An angel appears to the devout centurion Cornelius in Caesarea and instructs him to send for Peter in Joppa. At the same time, Peter receives a vision of a sheet containing unclean animals being lowered from heaven, with a voice saying that what God has cleansed, no one should call unclean. Peter goes to Cornelius, preaches the gospel, and the Holy Spirit falls upon the Gentiles who are then baptized.

versions.title: Peter's Vision in Joppa
versions.description: Peter sees a sheet with unclean animals and understands that the gospel is also for the Gentiles. He visits Cornelius.
